newsitem.title: USA: Montgomery County, Md., sees $100 mln golf payoff.
newsitem.headline: Montgomery County, Md., sees $100 mln golf payoff.

text.p: Golf is good for business in Montgomery County, according to local officials.
County Executive Doug Duncan said more than $100 million of new business would be generated from last weekend's Kemper Open and this weekend's U.S. Open golf tournaments.
Duncan said the tournaments themselves will raise about $40 million, and he believes fans will spend another $60 million at area shopping centers and restaurants.
The Kemper also donated $350,000 dollars to local charities.
